/bin/sh -c 'case "$TZ" in ""|Asia/Shanghai) export TZ=UTC;; esac; export PG_PREFIX="${PG_PREFIX:-wl_}"; if [ -n "$SECURE_DOMAINS" ] && [ -n "$RAILWAY_PUBLIC_DOMAIN" ]; then export SECURE_DOMAINS="$SECURE_DOMAINS,$RAILWAY_PUBLIC_DOMAIN"; fi; echo  | base64 -d | gunzip > /app/railway-init.js && node /app/railway-init.js && exec node /app/vanilla.js "${PORT:-8360}"'
